what: When the interaction enters the menu text, the brackets [ ] on both sides light up while the text goes blank, then .1s later it is rewritten in mixed-case English letters over .8s power3.out (width is fixed first so neighboring text does not shift). The brackets stay until writing finishes. With group set, it triggers on entering a row wrapped by that selector — the View in a work row (.6s power2.inOut) · the large text in a contact band (1s power2.inOut)

options.group: CSS selector — mixes when the hand enters the nearest ancestor (row or strip). If none, the attached element itself

from.where: shared.js [data-nav-scramble] header row · footer menu (.8s power3.out, .1s later) · index.js work row View (dur: .6; delay: 0; ease: power2.inOut; chars: a-z; group: li) · shared.js Contact band Get in touch (dur: 1; delay: 0; ease: power2.inOut; group: .fg-touch)
